name: Order of Saint George
description: This order, known as the 'Chivalric Society of Saint George,' embodies a commitment to the ideals of chivalry and honor, promoting these values through knightly tournaments and festivals.

name: Order of the Ermine
description: The Order of the Ermine draws inspiration from the [GetCountry('ENG').GetAdjective] Order of the Garter. With the ermine as its symbol, representing unwavering personal honor, the order recognizes both men and women, regardless of social status, for exceptional service to the Duchy of [ShowAreaName('brittany_area')].

name: Order of the Dragon
description: Also known as the '#italic Societas Draconica#!', this Order was dedicated to defending the [GetCountry('HUN').GetAdjective] monarchy, the [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] Church, and [ShowReligionGroupName('christian')] against the threat of the [GetCountry('TUR').GetLongName], heretics, and pagans. Modeled after the Order of St. George and inspired by the crusading spirit of the time, it unites the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] and the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')] under the symbols of the ouroboros and the red cross, fostering a collective defense against foreign and domestic threats while offering the $nobles_estate$ royal protection and honors in return for their loyalty.

name: Order of the Band
description: The Order of the Band is composed of the most excellent knights, who swear their loyalty and obedience to the ruler of [GetCountry('CAS').GetName]. Its members are held to high standards of scrupulous and impeccable courtly behavior, regularly participate in jousts, and must be above all else supportive and loyal to their ruler.

name: Order of the Swan
description: The Order of the Swan is dedicated to promoting piety and spreading the cult of the Virgin Mary. Members of this Order include many princes from the ruling dynasty as well as the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')], all united in perseverance.

name: Order of the Black Eagle
description: The secular Order of the Black Eagle is more of a military order than a spiritual one. Members of this Order tend to include members of the royal family, visiting foreign royals, and distinguished generals who have been awarded for their merit.

name: Order of the White Eagle
description: The military $order_of_the_white_eagle_policy$ is awarded to the closest supporters of the state and the most brilliant of our citizens as a reward for their service to the country. It is also bestowed upon high-ranking visitors who have graced us with their presence.

name: Order of the Garter
description: Established in the tradition of the legendary Knights of the Round Table, the Order of the Garter is the most prestigious [chivalric_order|e] in the realm. Its motto, '#italic Honi soit qui mal y pense#!', speaks to the honor demanded of its members.

name: Order of the Golden Fleece
description: Founded by Philip the Good of Burgundy, the Order of the Golden Fleece is among the most illustrious [chivalric_order|e]s in Christendom. Membership binds its knights by solemn oath to uphold the glory and honor of their lord, and to stand united against all threats to Christendom.
